description: Alex's registered laptop suffers accidental physical damage during an overseas internship-related trip. A documented repair estimate is USD 600. P3_GADGET is checked first as the specific gadget policy, and P2_TRAVEL is checked for possible overlapping baggage or electronics coverage.

expected_result.reason: P3 pays the eligible accidental damage claim after its USD 75 deductible. P2 pays nothing under the proposed explicit exclusion for physical damage to a device registered under separate gadget insurance. The combined payment cannot exceed the actual loss.
